notes.title: Greetings everyone!
notes.notes: [h1][b]Greetings everyone![/b][/h1][p]2xP Games are thrilled to announce that Fishing for Numbers, is coming to Steam. [/p][p]Fishing for Numbers is a vibrant, first-person educational adventure where you step into the shoes of an aspiring wizard on a quest to join the prestigious Arcane Anglers Guild. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/cfdc4c78f6b02724bf0d0b2a0e076f2e7a2d2cdf.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Entertaining and educational![/b][/h2][p]Master increasingly harder equations and catch magical fish to prove your worth and earn your place among the elite! Specialize in addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, or become a master of them all! Unlock the secrets of the guild by catching larger fish, thus unlocking new features and challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/bdcec366cf1b9d3d20d7edfb502c09eb39cb5243.png"][/img][/p][h2]Upcoming![/h2][p]The demo will be available 26th September and the game enters Early Access in 2025 Q4. Expected full release 2026 Q4. More details coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/ff835163d25bd572788663a2de0a34045851c27d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Wishlist the game on Steam![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p]
